{{Quote|Our village has been attack by Tusken Raiders! It was horrible, so many of my friends fell so swiftly, so few of us got away...|[[Tolan Nokkar]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TN" />}}
The '''Tusken Village''', simply known as '''the village''' by its denizens, was a small [[City/Legends|village]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the village was attacked and taken over by a tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by their [[Tusken King (rank)|Tusken King]].

==Description==
[[File:TuskenVillage2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Another perspective of the village]]
{{Quote|The village is out in the wastelands and not easy to find. I'll show you where it is on your datapad.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC" />}}
This humble [[City/Legends|village]] was located some distance north of the town of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The village was surrounded by a dilapidated wall perimeter, and consisted of three modest sized structures, three diminutive homes, and a couple of tents. In the center of the village was a single [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]].<ref name="SWG:TV" />

==History==
{{Quote|We were targeted by a Tusken War Party and we weren't able to hold them off! We're still hearty folk, though, so we're not leaving. Well, that is unless the King of the Tuskens stop killing us off. He's hunting us down one by one like we're Eopie or something.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC" />}}
[[File:TolanNokkarsRefugeeCamp-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The refugee camp used by Tolan Nokkar and other escaped villagers]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the village was attacked and taken over by a tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by their [[Tusken King (rank)|Tusken King]]. The village sustained damage, and most of the villagers were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Yet, a few of the villagers managed to escape, and established a refugee camp in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], not far from the village.<ref name="SWG:TN" /> Another survivor traveled to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] to seek help from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but the Empire refused to intervene.<ref name="SWG:AC" />

[[File:TuskenKingVillage.jpg|130px|thumb|The Tusken King who launched the attack on the village]]
[[Tolan Nokkar]], one of the villagers, encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and explained the dire situation. Nokkar pleaded with the spacer to kill the Tusken's [[King/Legends|King]], with the hope that it would drive the rest of the indigenous Sand People away. The spacer agreed, and set off towards the pillaged village to wipe out the Tusken King and any other Tuskens who would get in the way. Ultimately, the spacer succeeded and returned to Nokkar to report the news. Nokkar was thankful, and gave the spacer 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] pooled together by the surviving villagers as a token of their appreciation. Nokkar went on to say that they would move back into the village as soon as they formulated a plan to attack the remaining Tusken Raiders.<ref name="SWG:TN" />

In the meantime, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vi'conya T'ili]], whose family was killed by the Sand Peoples, encouraged any willing spacer to travel to the village and kill some Tuskens.<ref name="SWG:VT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Vi'conya T'ili|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken Village appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tolan Nokkar referred to the town as simply "the village",<ref name="SWG:TN" /> while the coordinates given by the commoner listed the location as the Tusken Village.<ref name="SWG:AC" /> If the player were to accept Tolan Nokkar's quest, the coordinate description would list the location as the "pillaged village".<ref name="SWG:TN" />
